mentions.name: Culink
mentions.description: This is a platform for curated, organized link collections that users can share and discover, described as Pinterest for links rather than random bookmarks. As of day 13 it has 27 collections live and other people are already creating their own collections.
mentions.problem: Random bookmarks are not organized or discoverable; the platform addresses this with organized, shareable link collections.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building Culink — a platform for curated link collections.

Not random bookmarks, but organized and shareable collections you can actually discover.
Think Pinterest for links.
